# Andre Almeida — Digital Strategy, Websites, Ecommerce & Automation

Canonical website: https://andre-almeida.online
Primary language: Portuguese (Brazil)
English version: https://andre-almeida.online/en
Portuguese version: https://andre-almeida.online/pt-BR

## About
Andre Almeida develops digital infrastructure for businesses, ecommerce brands, professionals and authors. Core work includes business websites, owned ecommerce, Shopify, CRM, email marketing, analytics, automation, AI systems, SEO/GEO, conversion optimization and online authority.

## Brazil / Portuguese services
- Websites profissionais para empresas e estabelecimentos comerciais em todo o Brasil
- E-commerce e loja virtual com infraestrutura própria ou Shopify, conforme o cenário
- CRM, captação de leads, pop-ups, formulários e mailing
- E-mail marketing, segmentação e automações
- Analytics comercial: origem, cidade aproximada, páginas, cliques, retornos e eventos de compra
- Carrinho, checkout, abandono, upsell, downsell, order bump e cross-sell
- Estratégia de SEO, GEO e autoridade online
- Websites e estrutura de venda direta para autores, livros e produtos digitais
- Integrações e automações com IA

## English services
- Business website development
- Owned ecommerce and Shopify development
- CRM and lead capture integrations
- Email marketing and automation
- Commercial analytics and conversion tracking
- Ecommerce conversion systems including cart, checkout, upsell, downsell, order bumps and cross-sells
- SEO, GEO and online authority strategy
- Direct-to-consumer websites for authors and book sales
- AI and workflow automation

## Contact
Use the website contact page or the WhatsApp buttons shown on the website for project inquiries.

## Accuracy notes
The site does not promise zero operating cost. Domain, hosting, email, payment processing and third-party services may have costs depending on the chosen architecture. The positioning is that ecommerce can be built without forcing the business to depend on a mandatory storefront-platform subscription simply for the store to exist.
